releaseNotes: v1.2.7: Added Smart OCR & Invoice-to-Delivery-Note conversion in Branded Document Studio (strips all prices, totals & non-goods fee rows, supports partial deliveries, offline ML Kit layout OCR, and automatic LPO price hydration from Vault Price Lists), 1-tap Delivery Note creation from any saved Invoice, and optional 'Include KRA PIN' toggles across Branded Documents, Invoices, and Monthly Statements.
